observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a black monitor with a glossy screen, placed on a tiled floor in front of a plastic-wrapped item. The screen is off and reflects the surroundings. A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI CHINONYEREM OKORAFOR' is visible.

Photo 1 shows the back of the same monitor. It is dark gray with a central rectangular cutout for cable management. A white sticker with a logo and text is visible on the upper left. Another sticker with a barcode is on the upper right. The same watermark is present.

Photo 2 is a close-up of the white sticker on the back. It reads 'Novus', '0800 688 9770', 'Passed', 'Date Tested', with 'Apr' and '2023' marked. A serial number '6036100' is on the left. The watermark is again visible.
